theater: 藏南高原與阿克賽欽邊線

battle.name: 中印邊境戰爭
battle.theater: 藏南高原與阿克賽欽邊線
battle.brief: 一九六二年十月二十日，解放軍在藏南與阿克賽欽兩翼同時發動攻勢，四日內連下零嘎、塔旺與楚舒爾一線，十一月十九日周恩來宣布停火。戰役靠迫擊砲與山炮決定山口歸屬。卡面這支一八五〇年德國線膛野戰砲代表的，正是砲兵以射程壓過步兵的技術路線；一九六二年由同族的後膛式野砲與迫擊砲延續。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 這場戰爭是中華人民共和國與印度共和國之間沿實際控制線爆發的邊境戰事，交戰主力是中國人民解放軍與印度軍隊。解放軍方面由總參謀部與新疆軍區統籌，東路即藏南方向由西藏方面部隊擔任，西路即阿克賽欽方向由新疆方面部隊擔任，投入第四、第五軍群及後續開進的兵團，並配屬工程兵、通信兵與後勤分隊；攻勢分作兩路，東路在零嘎河谷（Namka Chu）、瓦弄（Walong）與塔旺一線，西路在奇普查普（Chip Chap）河谷、班公湖與楚舒爾（Chushul）一線，兩個戰區相距約一千公里，攻勢在同一天發動。印度方面由陸軍本部指揮，開戰時戰區內只有兩個師，印軍以第四步兵師、第十山地師和各個山地旅承擔主要任務，第四軍團負責藏南方向；炮兵由炮兵部隊集中支援，工兵、通信兵、醫療與後勤按旅營編制跟進。雙方都沒有正式宣戰，戰事全程在地面進行，海軍與大規模空軍行動都沒有介入。
countriesEn: This war was a border conflict fought between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of India along the line of actual control, with the Chinese People's Liberation Army and the Indian Army as the opposing forces. On the Chinese side the campaign was directed by the PLA General Staff and the Xinjiang Military Region. The eastern prong, the southern sector, was the responsibility of the forward units facing Tibet; the western prong, the Aksai Chin, of the units coming out of Xinjiang. The Fourth Army Group, the Fifth Army Group and army groups moved up afterwards were committed, with engineer, signal and service detachments attached. The offensive was split in two: in the east along the Namka Chu valley, Walong and Tawang; in the west along the Chip Chap valley, Pangong Lake and Chushul. The two theatres lay about a thousand kilometres apart, and the attack was launched on the same day in both. On the Indian side the army headquarters directed the operations. At the outbreak only two divisions were present in the theatre, and the main burden fell on the 4th Infantry Division, the 10th Mountain Division and the various mountain brigades, with the Fourth Army Corps responsible for the southern sector. Artillery support was centralised in the artillery units, and engineer, signal, medical and service elements followed in brigade and battalion echelons. Neither side formally declared war; the whole campaign was fought on the ground, with no naval action and no large-scale use of air power.
people: 決定開打的是毛澤東，主持外交收尾的是周恩來。開戰前的判斷，核心是毛澤東把印軍不斷向前推進比作象棋中的渡河，認為對方既然已經越線，就必須一次性吃掉，否則邊境永遠不得安寧。國防部長林彪在一九六二年十月六日的高層會議上報告，解放軍情報判斷印軍將在十月十日對塔格拉山脊（Thagla Ridge）發動代號 Leghorn 的攻勢，中樞隨即決定大規模反擊，解放軍總參謀長黃永勝主持前線部署，新疆軍區司令員王震負責西線，西藏軍區司令員張國華負責東線。印方關鍵人物是總理尼赫魯與國防部長克里希那·梅塔，第四軍團指揮官 B. M. Kaul 少將在塔格拉方向調兵時仍認為攻勢會是孤注一擲，陸軍參謀總長 V. K. Mehra 少將則主張佔領整條麥克馬洪線。作戰層面上，各師旅指揮官在前線自主決斷，而駐美大使加爾布賴思與印度情報機構負責人穆利克都反對出動空軍，理由是中方可能報復。
peopleEn: Mao Zedong decided that there would be a war, and Zhou Enlai handled the diplomatic endgame. The judgement before the fighting began rested on Mao's reading of the Indian forward policy: he compared the Indians' constant pushing forward to crossing a river in Chinese chess, and held that since the other side had already crossed, it had to be eaten up in one stroke, otherwise the frontier would never be quiet. Defence Minister Lin Biao reported at a high level meeting on 6 October 1962 that PLA intelligence had determined the Indians would attack the Thagla Ridge on 10 October in an operation code-named Leghorn; the centre thereupon resolved on a large-scale counterattack. PLA Chief of the General Staff Huang Yongsheng ran the deployment, the commander of the Xinjiang Military Region Wang Zhen took the western prong and the commander of the Tibet Military Region Zhang Guohua the eastern one. On the Indian side the key figures were Prime Minister Nehru and Defence Minister Krishna Menon. The corps commander B. M. Kaul, commanding IV Corps, still believed the attack would be desperate when he moved troops in the Thagla direction, while the Chief of the Army Staff, V. K. Mehra, pressed for the occupation of the whole McMahon Line. At the operational level the divisional and brigade commanders took their own decisions in the front line, while the American ambassador John Kenneth Galbraith and the head of Indian intelligence, B. N. Mullick, both advised against using the air force, on the ground that China might retaliate.
kits: 卡面這件線膛野戰砲是一八五〇年德國即普魯士兵工廠的早期線膛野戰砲，線膛炮管、前膛裝填，射程比同期滑膛砲倍增，正是十九世紀中期砲兵第一次能在射程上壓過步兵的那道技術門檻；它在一九六二年早已淘汰逾一百年，戰場上不可能出現，但它開出的那條路一直延伸到本役的火砲。解放軍在藏南與阿克賽欽的火力以五三式一二〇毫米迫擊砲與五四式一二二毫米榴彈砲為主，另有八二毫米迫擊砲與七五毫米無後坐力砲；步兵輕武器為五六式半自動步槍、五六式自動步槍與五六式衝鋒槍，機槍有五三式重機槍與五六式輕機槍。印軍的輕武器仍以李-恩菲爾德七點六二毫米步槍為主力，配斯特林衝鋒槍與布侖機槍，火砲有二十五磅砲、一〇五毫米野砲、五點五吋砲、三點七吋山砲，迫擊砲有八十一毫米與一二〇毫米兩種。運輸方面，解放軍靠解放牌汽車、騾馬與犛牛背運，印軍靠吉普、貨車與大量騾馬，並配發雪地裝備與登山器材。通信器材在高山普遍不足，零嘎一線的印軍陣地與師部之間靠有線電話相連，開戰當日即遭炮火切斷。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun on the card is an early rifled field gun from the German, that is Prussian, arsenals of 1850. With a rifled barrel and loading from the muzzle, it doubled the range of the smoothbore guns of its day and marked the threshold at which artillery could for the first time outrange and beat infantry. It had been obsolete for more than a century by 1962 and could not of course appear on the battlefield, but the line it opened runs straight into the guns of this war. The artillery used by the PLA in the southern sector and in Aksai Chin consisted mainly of the 53-type 120mm mortar and the 54-type 122mm howitzer, with 82mm mortars and 75mm recoilless rifles. The infantry weapons were the 56-type semi-automatic rifle, the 56-type automatic rifle and the 56-type submachine gun, with the 53-type heavy machine gun and the 56-type light machine gun. The Indian light weapons were still centred on the 7.62mm Lee-Enfield rifle, with Sterling submachine guns and Bren light machine guns; their artillery included the 25-pounder, the 105mm field gun, the 5.5-inch gun and the 3.7-inch mountain gun, with 81mm and 120mm mortars. For transport the PLA relied on Jiefang trucks, mules and yaks carrying loads on their backs, while the Indians used jeeps, lorries and a great many mules, with issued snow clothing and mountaineering equipment. Communications equipment was scarce in the high mountains: the Indian positions in the Namka Chu valley were tied to their headquarters by field telephone, and those lines were cut by shellfire on the first day of the attack.
tactics: 解放軍的戰術重點是夜戰行軍、多路穿插、各個殲滅，靠迫擊砲與山炮的火力密度決定山口歸屬。零嘎一線最具代表性：印軍把兵力集中在五座橋的渡口，解放軍卻在枯水期涉水渡河，在夜色中於南岸編成營，凌晨五時十四分以迫擊砲火開始壓制，同時剪斷印軍電話線，六時三十分步兵從背後發動襲擊，隨後以連續迂迴把印軍逼離陣地。瓦弄一線，二十二日零時十五分解放軍迫擊砲開火，約四百人攻擊印軍陣地，第一波被印軍準確的迫擊砲火擋住，補充兵力後再攻，終以人數優勢突破；塔旺一線則在沒有遇到抵抗的情況下被放棄。十一月中旬戰事重啟：十七日解放軍不走公路，改走山徑攻擊塞拉與邦迪拉，切斷公路並割裂約一萬名印軍；十八日凌晨四時三十五分在楚舒爾方向發動密集步兵攻擊，五時四十五分打到古隆山（Gurung Hill），印軍砲兵未能頂住優勢兵力，九時前守軍退出古隆山與連接它的斯潘古山口。同時解放軍在熱藏拉（Rezang La）攻擊守軍一百二十三人的印軍陣地，遭到抵抗而未能得手。解放軍飛機全程未參戰；印軍雖曾要求出動空軍，但最終沒有把空軍投入攻勢作戰。
tacticsEn: The Chinese tactics rested on night movement, attack by several routes and destruction in separated groups, with the density of mortar and field gun fire deciding which pass would be held. The action in the Namka Chu valley is the clearest case. The Indians had concentrated on five crossings of the river, but the Chinese forded it in the shallows of the dry season, formed up into battalions on the southern bank under cover of darkness, opened with mortar fire at 5.14 in the morning, cut the Indian telephone lines at the same moment, and sent the infantry in from the rear at about 6.30, then rolled the defenders off their positions with a series of flanking moves. At Walong the Chinese mortars opened fire at 12.15 a.m. on 22 October and some four hundred men attacked the Indian positions; the first assault was checked by accurate Indian mortar fire, and only after reinforcement did a second assault break through, weight of numbers deciding the day. Tawang was abandoned without resistance. When the war resumed in mid November the Chinese changed their method on 17 November, approaching Se La and Bomdi La along a mountain trail rather than the road, cutting the road and isolating some ten thousand Indian troops. Early on 18 November, at 4.35 in the morning, they launched a dense infantry attack in the Chushul sector, striking Gurung Hill at 5.45; Indian artillery could not hold off the superior numbers and the defenders withdrew from Gurung Hill and from the connecting Spangur Gap by nine o'clock. At the same time the Chinese attacked Rezang La, held by 123 Indian troops, and were repulsed there. The PLA committed no aircraft at all. The Indians did press for the air force to be used, but in the end did not commit it to the offensive.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。印度主張的邊界全長三千四百八十八公里，阿克賽欽爭議區約三萬八千平方公里，藏南的東北邊疆署轄區約九萬平方公里，阿克賽欽平均海拔約五千米；東、西兩個戰區相距約一千公里。兵力方面，解放軍投入約八萬人，印方投入約二萬二千人，而開戰時印軍在戰區內只有兩個師，準備嚴重不足。時間軸上，一九六二年六月印軍在塔格拉山脊下的多拉哨所建立，八月中方佔領山脊頂部，九月二十日零嘎爆發交火，十月十日印軍一支五十人的拉其普特巡邏隊在玉姆措拉撞上約一千人的解放軍工事陣地，十月二十日東西兩路同時進攻，十月二十二日至二十四日連下零嘎、塔旺、瓦弄與楚舒爾北面的哨所，十月二十六日周恩來致信尼赫魯提出雙方各退二十公里的方案，十月二十七日尼赫魯回信，十一月十四日印軍在瓦弄反攻，十一月十七日塞拉與邦迪拉失守，十一月十八日楚舒爾與熱藏拉打成僵持，十一月十九日周恩來宣布十一月二十一日午夜起停火，十二月一日起解放軍開始後撤，十二月下旬完成。傷亡方面，中方公布陣亡七百二十二人、受傷一千六百九十七人，印方則宣稱在熱藏拉擊斃解放軍一千三百餘人；印方自己的統計為陣亡一千三百八十三人、失蹤一千六百九十六人、受傷五百四十八至一千零四十七人、被俘三千九百六十八人，中方來源亦記印軍被俘三千九百六十八人。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The border claimed by India runs for three thousand four hundred and eighty-eight kilometres; the disputed area of Aksai Chin covers about thirty-eight thousand square kilometres, the North-East Frontier Agency administered by India about ninety thousand, and the average altitude of Aksai Chin is about five thousand metres. The two theatres lay roughly a thousand kilometres apart. On strength, the PLA committed about eighty thousand men and India about twenty-two thousand, while only two Indian divisions were present in the theatre at the outbreak, and the preparations were badly inadequate. On the timeline: in June 1962 the Indians established Dhola Post below the Thagla Ridge; in August Chinese troops occupied the top of the ridge; on 20 September fighting broke out at Namka Chu; on 10 October an Indian Rajput patrol of fifty men at Yumtso La ran into an emplaced Chinese position of about a thousand men; on 20 October the two prongs attacked simultaneously; between 22 and 24 October Namka Chu, Tawang, Walong and the outposts north of Chushul fell; on 26 October Zhou Enlai wrote to Nehru proposing a mutual withdrawal of twenty kilometres, and Nehru replied on the 27th; on 14 November the Indians counterattacked at Walong; on 17 November Se La and Bomdi La were lost; on 18 November Chushul and Rezang La deadlocked; on 19 November Zhou declared a ceasefire from midnight on 21 November; the Chinese began withdrawing from 1 December and finished later that month. On casualties, China published 722 dead and 1,697 wounded, while India claimed to have killed more than 1,300 Chinese at Rezang La; the Indian figures are 1,383 dead, 1,696 missing, 548 to 1,047 wounded and 3,968 captured, and Chinese sources record the same 3,968 Indian prisoners.
cause: 直接起因是實際控制線一線長期存在的進退之爭。一九五四年中印協定以和平共處五項原則為框架，約定以現有實際控制線為基礎談判解決邊界問題；一九五六年中國政府明確提出阿克賽欽在中國境內，印方不接受。一九五九年十一月七日周恩來在德里與尼赫魯會談，雙方同意以實際控制線作為邊界線，此後數年談判反而停滯。一九六〇年雙方再就邊界方案交換意見而無結果，印軍在此期間不斷以巡邏與前哨哨位向南推進，越出實際控制線，中方視之為逐步兼併。印軍在這一線的越界有實際事例：十月二十日前的塔格拉山脊爭奪中，一支五十人的印度巡邏隊在玉姆措拉撞上約一千人的解放軍工事陣地，毫無接觸準備即被包圍。印度國內的判斷則輕敵，軍方在戰前普遍認為不會開戰，九月的估計甚至認為幾發炮彈就能把中國人趕走。十月六日解放軍高層會議判定印軍將在十月十日攻擊塔格拉山脊，中樞隨即決定以大規模反擊予以懲戒，十四日人民日報發出最後警告，十月二十日東西兩路同時開火。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the long running argument over who would give way along the line of actual control. The 1954 Sino-Indian agreement was framed by the five principles of peaceful coexistence and provided that the boundary would be settled by negotiation on the basis of the existing line of actual control. In 1956 the Chinese government stated explicitly that Aksai Chin lay within Chinese territory, and India would not accept this. On 7 November 1959 Zhou Enlai met Nehru in Delhi and the two agreed to take the line of actual control as the boundary line; the talks then made no further progress for several years. The two sides exchanged proposals on the boundary in 1960 without result, and in the meantime Indian patrols and posts kept pushing south across the line, which Beijing read as incremental annexation. There were concrete cases of Indian encroachment: in the fighting for the Thagla Ridge before 20 October, a fifty-strong Indian patrol met an emplaced Chinese position of about a thousand men at Yumtso La and was surrounded with no chance to make contact. Indian judgement at home was complacent, the army generally assuming that no war would come, and a September estimate held that a few rounds would send the Chinese running. At the high level meeting of 6 October the Chinese leadership concluded that the Indians would attack the Thagla Ridge on 10 October, and resolved on a large-scale counterattack as punishment. The People's Daily issued a final warning on the 14th, and the two prongs struck on 20 October.
impact: 戰後的邊界局勢與雙方的軍隊都改了樣子。藏南河谷與阿克賽欽西段留在中國控制之下，實際控制線整體西移；印方在此後二十多年把主要邊疆精力放在西線對付巴基斯坦。印度國內震動更大：國防部長克里希那·梅塔辭職，軍隊指揮層被大改組，政府委託的調查寫成亨德森-布魯克斯-巴加特報告，檢討敗因；軍隊在兩年內把兵力擴充到一倍以上，並全面重做高海拔作戰的訓練、後勤與裝備。國際上，埃及、緬甸、柬埔寨、斯里蘭卡、加納與印尼六國於一九六二年十二月十日在科倫坡會商，只要求中國單方面後撤二十公里，未能指責中國，令印度失望；美國在一九六三年五月的國安會議上討論了中國再度攻擊印度時的應變方案，並一度考慮核選項；蘇聯因古巴導彈危機無暇他顧，但中印交惡後蘇聯加快向印度供應武器。巴基斯坦在一九六二年十月與中國開始邊界談判，一九六三年簽訂中巴邊界條約，放棄了克什米爾北部的北線主張。此後局勢一路演變，一九六七年那木拉與巧拉再起衝突，一九八七年雙方克制未開火，一九九三與一九九六年先後簽訂雙邊和平與相互信任條約，二〇〇六年七月乃堆拉口岸重新開放，二〇一一年底雙方同意自二〇一二年恢復年度防務對話。
impactEn: After the war the border situation and the armed forces of both sides had changed. The southern valleys of the eastern sector and western Aksai Chin remained under Chinese control and the line of actual control shifted west as a whole; India for the next two decades concentrated its main frontier effort on the western sector against Pakistan. The shock inside India was greater. Defence Minister Krishna Menon resigned, the command structure of the army was reshuffled, and the government commissioned an inquiry that produced the Henderson Brooks-Bhagat report on the causes of the defeat; the army more than doubled its manpower within two years and overhauled its training, logistics and equipment for warfare at high altitude. Internationally, six non-aligned states, Egypt, Burma, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Ghana and Indonesia, met at Colombo on 10 December 1962, asked only that China withdraw twenty kilometres unilaterally and declined to condemn China, which disappointed India. In May 1963 the United States National Security Council discussed contingency planning for a further Chinese attack and briefly considered nuclear options, while the Soviet Union, absorbed by the Cuban Missile Crisis, had no time to spare but soon increased its arms supply to India once Sino-Indian relations soured. Pakistan opened border negotiations with China in October 1962 and in 1963 signed the China-Pakistan border treaty, dropping its claim to the northern line in Kashmir. From there the situation ran on: clashes at Nathu La and Cho La in 1967, a bloodless mutual standoff in 1987, the bilateral peace and tranquility accords of 1993 and 1996, the reopening of the Nathu La crossing on the Silk Road in July 2006, and the agreement of late 2011 to resume the annual defence dialogue from 2012.
result: 就一九六二年這一役的直接結果而言：解放軍在戰術上取得全面勝利，零嘎河谷、塔旺、瓦弄與楚舒爾北面的哨所逐一易手，印軍第四師退守塞拉與邦迪拉仍被割裂，約一萬人被切斷在公路一線，解放軍前鋒一度推進到距阿薩姆邦邊境約五十公里的德茲普爾方向，印軍在塔旺方向未作抵抗即撤出。只有熱藏拉一役解放軍攻不下守軍一百二十三人的陣地，是全役少數中國軍吃虧的戰鬥。停火由周恩來於十一月十九日宣布，十一月二十一日午夜生效，條款寫明：自十二月一日起解放軍邊防部隊退到一九五九年十一月七日實際控制線後方二十公里，東線退到麥克馬洪線以北並再後撤二十公里，中線與西線退到實際控制線後方二十公里；十二月一日起部隊開始離開印方管轄區，十二月下旬完成撤退。實際控制線往西移了數十公里，藏南河谷與阿克賽欽西段並未交還。長期結果是一條沒有斷線的僵持：一九六七年那木拉與巧拉的衝突中解放軍被迫退出錫金，一九八七年雙方克制，二〇一七年出現對峙，二〇二〇年中印士兵在加勒萬河谷再度交火並出現傷亡，二〇二二年又有揚茨事端。半個多世紀裡，兩國在實際控制線上再沒有爆發大規模地面戰。
resultEn: As to the immediate outcome of the 1962 campaign: China won a complete tactical victory. The Namka Chu valley, Tawang, Walong and the outposts north of Chushul changed hands one after another. The Indian 4th Division fell back on Se La and Bomdi La and was cut off, some ten thousand men isolated along the road, and the Chinese spearhead advanced to within about fifty kilometres of the Assam frontier in the direction of Tezpur, while the Indians abandoned Tawang without resistance. Only at Rezang La did the Chinese fail to take a position held by 123 Indian troops, one of the few Chinese reverse of the whole campaign. The ceasefire was announced by Zhou Enlai on 19 November and took effect at midnight on 21 November, its terms stating that from 1 December the Chinese frontier guards would withdraw to positions twenty kilometres behind the line of actual control that had existed on 7 November 1959, that in the eastern sector they would withdraw to the north of the McMahon Line and twenty kilometres back from it, and that in the middle and western sectors they would withdraw twenty kilometres from the line of actual control. From 1 December the troops began leaving Indian administered territory and the withdrawal was completed later in December. The line of actual control had moved west by tens of kilometres; the southern valleys and western Aksai Chin were not given back. The long term result was a standoff that never broke: Chinese forces were forced out of Sikkim in the clashes at Nathu La and Cho La in 1967, both sides showed restraint in 1987, there was a standoff in 2017, soldiers of both sides were killed in the Galwan Valley fighting of 2020, and there was a further clash in 2022. For more than half a century the two countries did not fight another large-scale ground war on the line of actual control.
